Teaching.title: Teaching
Teaching.description: A user-taught fact, preference, rule, or piece of knowledge for personalizing AI interactions.

userId.description: The UID of the user who taught this fact or rule.

category.description: Category of the teaching: personal, preference, rule, work, or general.

content.description: The exact fact, instruction, preference, or rule taught to the AI.

importance.description: Priority level of the teaching: normal, high, or core.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: A conversational message exchanged between the user and the AI assistant.

userId.description: The UID of the owning user.

role.description: The message author: user or model.

content.description: The text content of the message.

/users/{userId}/teachings/{teachingId}.description: Collection of user-taught personalization knowledge and instructions.

/users/{userId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Collection of chat interaction history for cross-device synchronization.
